headings.h1: Line charts for trends over time

intro: Plot one or more numeric series against a shared category or time axis. LineChart composes Recharts `Line` primitives with shared decorators for grid, axes, tooltip, and legend.
useCases: Revenue or usage trends by week.
Conversion funnels as simple step trends.

faqs.question: How do I add another series?
faqs.answer: Append an entry to `series` with a distinct `dataKey` that exists on each datum; optional `name` and palette `color` keys customize the legend and stroke.

faqs.question: Can lines share a sync id?
faqs.answer: Pass `syncId` to coordinate tooltips or brushing across multiple charts that use the same identifier.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
Renders monotone lines with configurable grid, tooltip, and legend.

Control density and frame appearance with tokens instead of one-off CSS.

sections.heading: Data shape
sections.body: Each row is an object; `xKey` names the categorical or ordinal field; numeric fields back each `series.dataKey`.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body:
Provide meaningful `name` values for series so tooltips and legends read clearly.

Validate contrast for axes and labels against your chosen `appearance` background.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Import from `@zentauri-ui/zentauri-components/charts/line` inside client components when interaction is required.
